voyages.notes: Three ships sailing together; the Virginia Company's first settlers.
About 102 passengers; roughly half died in the first winter.
The colony's first resupply; about 35 passengers.
Sailed in company with the Anne.

Eleven ships led by the Arbella — Talbot, Ambrose, Jewel, Mayflower, Whale, Success, Charles, William and Francis, Hopewell, Trial — carrying 700 to 1,000 Puritans. Import per ship where a transcription distinguishes them.
voyages.source: Charles Edward Banks, The Winthrop Fleet of 1630 (1930); Robert Charles Anderson, The Winthrop Fleet (2012); Wikipedia: Winthrop Fleet — https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Winthrop_Fleet
